Objet : recueil « Les Saisons de Velmira:
Subject: the collection "The Seasons of Velmira", T. VARGA, revised edition of 1986.

The initials of the six lines of the poem "November" form the word HALVEK. The town of Halvek lies in the border zone. The poem evokes a train, a platform, hands "guarded" and "kilometres": vocabulary characteristic of smuggling routes.

The author works at a State printing works and may have circulated other texts there.

Conclusion: coded message, intended for a network of smugglers. Arrest recommended.
